featured_reviews.name: Master Manish
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited this restaurant, and my experience was extremely disappointing. From the moment the food arrived, I knew things were not going to go well. The presentation looked messy and unappetizing, as if it had been thrown together in a hurry. The dishes were served lukewarm, and some items were even cold by the time they reached our table.

The taste was the biggest letdown. The flavours were completely off — bland, oily, and nowhere close to what was mentioned in the menu. The vegetables were soggy, the bread was stale, and the gravy tasted like it came out of a packet. Even the basics like rice and dal were poorly cooked. For the price they charge, the quality was absolutely unacceptable.

To make things worse, the service was just as bad. The staff seemed uninterested, slow, and unbothered by our complaints. Instead of apologizing or trying to fix anything, they acted as if we were disturbing them.

Overall, this was one of the most unpleasant dining experiences I’ve had. I would not recommend this place to anyone. The food was terrible, the service was unprofessional, and the entire visit felt like a complete waste of money and time.

⸻

We had a wonderful dining experience at Soul Restaurant, Hotel Oriental Residency, Khar. It was a lunch Innerwheel meeting. The food was absolutely delicious—fresh, flavorful, and beautifully prepared. Every dish reflected great quality and care.

What truly made the experience exceptional was the impeccable service. A special mention to Mr. Arun Shetty (Supervisor) and Mr. Ravi Tandel (Manager) for their attentive leadership and warm hospitality. They ensured everything was seamless and made us feel genuinely welcomed.

Kudos also to the servers Sapan, Sunil, and Virendar for their courteous, prompt, and friendly service. Their professionalism and positive attitude added greatly to our dining pleasure.

featured_reviews.review_text: Really enjoyed the food here. The malai tikka was super soft and flavorful, probably the best thing we ordered. Fried rice was also good – simple but tasty. Service was polite and quick, and the place had a nice relaxed vibe even though it was a Sunday night. Overall, a solid spot I’d come back to.

featured_reviews.name: Himesh Pudaruth
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently dined at the restaurant inside the hotel and had a very enjoyable experience. The ambiance was elegant and well-maintained, with a calm and comfortable atmosphere—perfect for both business meetings and relaxed meals.
The service was excellent, as expected from a hotel setting. The staff were professional, courteous, and attentive without being intrusive. They were also helpful in recommending dishes from the menu.
The food quality was impressive. Each dish was beautifully presented and tasted fresh and flavorful. The menu offered a good variety of options, catering to different preferences. While the prices were slightly on the higher side, it felt justified given the quality, service, and overall experience.
Overall, it’s a great place for a refined dining experience, and I would definitely recommend it to anyone visiting the hotel or looking for a classy meal.

Special thank to Arun.

featured_reviews.name: Richa Dharia
featured_reviews.review_text:
What a complete disappointment ordering from Bluebop. I ordered a pizza expecting basic quality and hygiene, but what I received was far from acceptable. The chilli flakes that came along with the pizza were clearly very old—they had turned black and looked almost rusty. It was genuinely disgusting to even see, let alone consider using.

This raises serious concerns about how ingredients are stored and handled. If something as basic as packaged chilli flakes is in such poor condition, it makes you question the overall hygiene and quality standards of the kitchen.

I did not expect this level of negligence. Food safety should be the absolute minimum standard, and this experience completely missed the mark. I would strongly urge the team to review their quality checks and storage practices. Very disappointing, and not something I would recommend.

The Pizza was below average too

Ordered an avocado, dates drink + almond milk. The original price was Rs 760, and then they deducted the service charge and brought it to Rs 692. Are you kidding me?

If you want to compete with other better cafes & coffee spots, you can’t be charging 700 bucks for one drink. This drink had avocado, dates and spinach lol.

Will not be coming here again, and definitely do not recommend this spot to ANYONE. Terribly priced is my feedback to the management. Passed the feedback to the team, they said they aren’t authorised to do anything; which is fair!

Zatar is right opposite, I recommend going there!

The ambiance of the cafe adds to the experience. The vibe is cozy and welcoming, with a great mix of modern and vintage decor that makes you want to stay and relax for hours. The soft lighting and comfortable seating create the perfect setting for a casual hangout or a quiet meal alone. Plus, the music is always spot on, enhancing the overall mood.

Whether you're a foodie or just looking for a cool place to unwind, Bluebop Cafe is a must-visit in Khar West.

featured_reviews.review_text:

It has both a (smaller) outdoor section and (comparatively larger) indoor section.
Liked the decor which was simple and minimalistic.
Ordered the Peri Peri Mushroom Pizza (12 inch). The taste was good but pretty expensive !
Service is okay as they did mix up the order and brought me Chicken Pizza initially. Luckily for them i was on a call and they understood the mistake themselves and changed it. However I did end up waiting 30min for my Pizza!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Blue bop cafe

The Chicken and mushroom soup was pleasant.
The steak was done to our preference. Completely insipid sauce. We had to ask for HP sauce, which they didn't have. We had to make do with ketchup and Tabasco.

There was a DJ playing light music, and we later got to know that the vibe gets more lively with people dancing post 10 PM, but we left early so couldn’t experience that part.
In terms of food, we ordered noodles, a chicken starter, and a few mocktails. The taste was decent but nothing exceptional. Pricing-wise, it didn’t feel very economical for what we had.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Raasta Bombay with a friend, and the experience was nothing short of memorable. The rooftop ambience, combined with great food and a lively atmosphere, made for a perfect evening. The Caribbean-themed lounge, inspired by Rastafari culture, has a vibrant and energetic vibe, with peppy music and live performances adding to the charm.

The staff members were incredibly friendly and proactive, ensuring we had a seamless dining experience. The food was packed with flavor, and the menu offered a great mix of Continental, Chinese, Italian, and fast food options. Everything we ordered was well-prepared and delicious.

Raasta Bombay truly stands out as a nightlife destination, with its well-curated events, upbeat music, and a welcoming ambience. Whether you’re looking to relive old memories or create new ones, this place is a must-visit in Mumbai. Looking forward to coming back!

We ate way too much, ordering in the app is great for foreigners that do not know all the items. Good mix of veggie and meat options from all different cuisines. We had an absolute blast.

We have tried a lot from the menu, on Saturday afternoon. We ordered a chicken platter, some were delicious while some were okayish. Mocktails are okayish. Pizza was amazing!! The pahadi chicken was good.  And then of course the dessert, it was sooooo good that we had to repeat it.

The ambiance is rustic. We felt our table lacked lights. They also have outdoor seating. It was a match day so of course the match was going on along with preparation for the night event.

The service was a bit slow but the server was really impressive with his suggestions, one extra star for him!

A good playful vibe, can try!

featured_reviews.name: Atharva Rao
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an amazing time at Social tonight. Great energy, solid crowd, amazing music and the food absolutely delivered. But the real highlight was Munawar.

One of the most attentive, warm and genuinely professional waiters I’ve come across in a long time. He handled everything effortlessly even during peak rush hours, kept checking in at the right moments without being intrusive, gave great recommendations and made the entire experience feel premium and comfortable.

Hospitality like this genuinely changes the vibe of a place. Staff members like Munawar are a huge reason people come back. Massive respect to him and the entire team at Social Khar for maintaining such a lively yet welcoming atmosphere.

featured_reviews.name: Apurva Prajapati
featured_reviews.review_text: We went there on Friday night and the experience was great! The DJ was superb! Also, there were many partners of the DJ and they were also good performers. To add a cherry on the cake, Prince Narula also visited the place at the same time and rapped on a song. We loved it. Enjoyed the place. Keep up guys!

featured_reviews.review_text: Social is generally known for its reliable food, lively atmosphere, and enjoyable outings with friends. However, my recent visit to the Khar location unfortunately fell short of expectations. The quality of the food was disappointing across the board, with several dishes falling flat. I suspect the chicken may have been stale, as it didn't taste fresh. Overall, it was a subpar experience.

featured_reviews.name: Sidharth Jhawar
featured_reviews.review_text: This vibrant establishment offers a delightful dining experience with its energetic atmosphere.  The menu boasts a selection of incredibly tasty dishes, all offered at very reasonable prices.  Every bite is a burst of flavor, showcasing fresh ingredients and culinary expertise.  The ambiance is truly captivating, creating a warm and inviting space for any occasion. Their non alcoholic beverages were a blast. I especially recommend their spiced guavava juice. The service was slightly slow, especially for Indian thali. Their chinese thali was great tasting and covered a variety of different elements. I highly recommend experiencing this gem for yourself.

featured_reviews.name: abhishek yenji
featured_reviews.review_text:
The service here is extremely poor. The waitstaff seriously need training in basic customer service. When asked about the menu, they respond with an attitude, simply telling customers to check the app or scanner. Yet, even after placing an order, we were twice informed that certain items were unavailable.

The food is decent but lacks essentials—no dips served with wings or burgers. Portions are also noticeably small, likely to make the menu seem more “exclusive.”

Service Charge: They automatically add a 10% tip, which they absolutely do not deserve. We requested its removal, and they complied. If they refuse, don’t hesitate to call the authorities.

Would not recommend this place based on service alone.

Good to relax and rejuvenate the day. We tried Lotus stems which was tasty. Mocktail was average. featured_reviews.name: Arjika S
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Veranda, Khar — and absolutely loved it!

Right from the moment I entered, the vibe was immaculate. The ambiance is fresh, lively, and aesthetic — like a cozy, lush garden tucked inside the city. Definitely one of those places where you feel relaxed the moment you sit down.

Drinks (Mocktails):
Started off with a Mixed Berry Lemonade — a refreshing burst of raspberry, blueberry, cranberry, and a dash of lemonade. Perfectly balanced between sweet and tangy — super refreshing!
Also tried their Tiramisu Espresso Martini mocktail — basically dessert in a glass. Creamy, smooth, with that rich coffee + tiramisu flavour, minus the booze. Loved it.

Starters:
We tried four starters and honestly, not a single miss:
•	Singapore Chili Prawns – spicy, bold, and cooked just right. Absolute banger if you love a little heat.
•	Butter Chicken Poutine – buttery, creamy chicken served over crispy fries — comfort food at its best!
•	Peri-Peri Chicken Tenders – juicy, crispy, and perfectly spiced. Loved the peri-peri twist!
•	Dhaba Style Chicken Platter – smoky, masaledar, and packed with desi flavors. A true soul-satisfying dish.

Every starter was flavorful, well-cooked, and beautifully plated. Portion sizes were pretty decent too.

Dessert:
Ended the meal with a Baileys Tiramisu — and honestly, it was the perfect finish. Creamy, luscious layers with a hint of Baileys — just the right amount of indulgence.

Service:
The staff was super polite, friendly, and gave good recommendations. Special shoutout to the bartender who explained the mocktails and even customized them a bit to our taste. Loved the attention to detail!

Overall:
The vibe, the food, the service — everything was a win. Perfect for a chill night out or a lowkey celebration.
Would absolutely come back for the Butter Chicken Poutine and that insane Tiramisu Mocktail combo!

featured_reviews.name: Indradeep Roy
featured_reviews.review_text:
Drive slow as you get close to the destination. It’s in the corner of a road and difficult to spot the branding. Located on the 1st floor. Valet parking available

The bar is the middle with nice cozy seating and ambiance. The stage is at one corner and mostly the restaurant is known for their live performances. The sound system is really good to help the cause of the performers.

The food is delivered pretty fast. Thus if you are in to enjoy the music, eat slowly else they would be quite quick to get a table ready for the next guest.

I liked the place and the food. Would like to come back

featured_reviews.name: Shivani Panchal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Located within walking distance from Khar Station and situated on the 1st floor, this place stands out for its lively ambience and live music. The food is average in taste. We went on Saturday and there was no waiting.
The music can get quite loud, making it less ideal for those who prefer a calm setting for conversation. If you're here for the vibe more than the food, it’s worth a visit.

featured_reviews.name: Shaikh Khalid Sarfaraz
featured_reviews.review_text:
Veranda is located on the main SV road Khar and it is easy to locate.

The restaurant is located on the 1st floor and the huge glass wall gives nice view of the road. The space is nice with seatings available for all size of groups. Loved the lightings done and they have a special zone for live music which is held between Friday to Sunday. The bar looks great and the overall vibe of this place is perfect for all type of occasions.

The menu consists multi cuisine hence the variety available is excellent. From Indian to Chinese to Italian and a lot more in covered. Prices are not too high and the quantity served is great.

Went here on a Thursday dinner and the DJ played nice Bollywood songs. Kitchen service was on time and table service by staff Worngam & Kevin was perfect.

What We Had -
APPETISERS~
Loaded Nachos -
Doritos topped with salsa, beans, guacamole and cheese sauce looked amazing and tasted equally good. The cheese sauce tasted creamy and the beans were perfectly cooked. Everything in this dish was fresh hence loved eating this.

Dhaba Chicken Platter -
3 types of chicken tikkas served on spicy sauce along with green chutney tasted nice. Loved the grilling of the chicken and the taste of all the variants was good.

Singapore Chilli Prawns -
This was excellent primarily due to the size and freshness of the prawns. Sweet spicy sauce along with bell peppers, onions and prawns tasted delicious. Loved eating this as the sauce plus the prawns tasted great together.

MAINS~
Cheesy Alfredo Pasta -
Basic yet super tasty. Penne done in creamy cheesy sauce with crunchy fresh veggies tasted great. Loved the taste firstly due to cheese and secondly due to right amount of garlic and herbs in it.

Blue Pea & Edamame Fried Rice -
Looked beautiful and tasted nice. Loved the light rice but the crunchy edamame and finely chopped veggies were really good in this.

DESSERTS~
Flourless Chocolate Cake -
This is one of the best tasting flourless cake. Not too sweet and very gooey and chocolatey. I can eat two of these.

BEVERAGES~
Indian Sunrise.
Virgin Pina Colada.
Berry Ice Tea.
All the drinks were really good and refreshing.

So our meal at Veranda Khar was a great experience due to the ambience, nice music and tasty food. Will definitely visit again to experience the live music. Till then you guys should definitely try this.

featured_reviews.name: The Hogger Bloggers
featured_reviews.review_text:
Veranda’s new outlet in Khar doesn’t disappoint at all. This one is located right at SV road and on the first floor. A similar cosy ambience with live music, refreshing drinks and their ever tasty food. It was truly an experience to behold.

Taking you through all the food we had here:

Crackling Chicken

Succulent chunks of chicken marinated with a flavourful seasoning and served with crispy spinach.

Bombay’s Koliwada Fish (Recommended)

Served in skewers, the special koliwada fish was crispy on the outside and tender on the inside.

Singaporean Chilli Prawns (Recommended)

Prawns prepared in a combination of dry red chilli and garlic. King size and absolutely delicious.

Legendary Butter Chicken With Garlic Naan

Our all-time favourite butter chicken which includes tandoor roasted chicken and is quite creamy. Tastes really yum alongside garlic naan.

Burnt Garlic Chicken Fried Rice

Indo Chinese style fried rice that is smoky, scrumptious and tastes even better with add-on chicken.

MOCKTAILS

Mixed Berry Lemonade that was a combination of blueberry, raspberry & cranberry.

Indian Sunrise which had a hint of peach and orange juice. A sweet treat.

From delicious food to spectacular ambience, we just couldn’t have enough of it. It is the perfect place to go out on a date, quite aesthetic. Not a bad place to come out with your friends as well. You have to visit this place for the vibes!

Locomo Express Hostel recommended Khoa Piyo Restaurant, and I visited there alone for dinner.

I asked for Kingfisher Ultra, and the manager initially confirmed that it was available. However, after a few minutes, another staff member came and informed me that it was not available and that only other brands were in stock. I then requested Budweiser, which was served.

The beer was served without any complimentary snacks like nuts or chips. I also had to ask separately for drinking water, whereas normally water is brought to the table automatically for customers.

I ordered chicken biryani, which was just okay.

After finishing my meal, I requested the bill, and the brought the QR code for payment. However, the manager took the bill from my hand with visible irritation, which felt uncomfortable and unprofessional.

When I was leaving, no staff member was present at the door to open it or even acknowledge me. Two staff members were sitting near the entrance, talking to each other, but there was no courtesy, greeting, or farewell shown.

Overall, I felt the service lacked basic hospitality, professionalism, and customer respect. I hope the management will take this feedback positively and improve their service standards.

featured_reviews.name: Danish Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Toooo Goooddd!!! This place offers so many cuisines that your mind will be confused right from the start. It includes everything from indian and sindhi to mexican, italian and arabic; also offers asian and exotic food items such as fondues. Has a seating area on entry and on the first floor too. Coming to my experience here, it was a mixed review since we had problems related to the air-conditioner and it's management. We sat on the first floor and there's a staircase to reach there. Ambience at both the levels is great and superb!! While the ambience was great, the air-conditioner was equally unrewarding since they weren't working properly. We even reported that to the staff but they said that they already know it's not working and started pretending that they've called the technicians at 4 in the evening the same day!! So even after coming through such scorching heat outside, the inside wasn't much different. Finally after shifting places thrice, we found a spot where cool air could be felt! Apart from all this the food was sooo yummy, fresh and adequate in quantity that my brain didn't have any other issue to focus on!🙌
Food review-
1.Cream of Tomato with Basil soup- 5/5 for quantity, 5/5 for taste. Also they serve extra croutons if asked for!!🤭
2. Pahadi paneer tikka- 5/5 for quantity, 5/5 for taste. The paneer pieces were soooo soft and felt really fresh!!
3. Lasagne Ala Napolitano- 3/5 for quantity, 4/5 for taste. Was less in quantity as compared to other places i've had lasagne. Less cheesy as per the standard flavour of lasagne.
4. Dum aloo punjabi- 10/5 for quantity, 10/5 for taste. Reallly reallly very goood in everythinggg from quantity to taste to the dum aloo pieces. Usually 1 potato is provided but here 2 were provided and it's masala and gravy was also soo yummm!!!😋
5. Butter kulcha- 5/5 for taste. Soft, fresshhhh and buttery!!
6. Chinese sizzler- 1/5 for quantity and 1/5 for taste. Typically a chinese sizzler consists of rice, noodles, manchurian balls, chinese gravy and sautéd veggies. But this consisted just of rice, noodles and sautéd veggies. There were no manchurian balls nor there was any gravy which adds to the taste in sizzlers. REALLY A BIG WASTE OF MONEY, I WOULDN'T RECOMMEND YOU TO ORDER ANY SIZZLER AFTER TRYING THIS ONE AS THIS WAS OVERPRICED AS COMPARED TO ANY OTHER PLACE.
7. Basil Citrus Breeze Margarita- 5/5 for look, 3/5 for taste. Looks too fancy and delicious but is just okay. Full of ice and  essence. Won't matter if you don't try this.

featured_reviews.review_text: Despite having an enormous menu, I’d suggest you stick to their Indian cuisine, particularly the fish dishes. featured_reviews.name: RCD thefoodie
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was recently introduced to authentic Sindhi food and I have to admit it’s one of the tastiest delicacies in the list of our Indian cuisines. Not many people are fond of it, cos you hardly have restaurants serving authentic, traditional dishes. But once you get to taste the original varieties you will be highly amazed.
I had a pop up event to attend @ khar and I met some good set of foodie friends over there who were equally excited like me to try out this outlet at khar. As I regularly visit the Lower Parel outlet I was damn sure that my friends would love their food. And as expected warm welcome, fabulous staff and amazing Sindhi menu to choose from.

We ordered:
🔹Beejiya di Tikki - Unique combination of lotus stem along with potatoes tasted so good, not to forget the crispy tangy fritter of lotus stem on top adds to the crunch of this soft tikkis.Highly recommended👍
🔹Kachari- Ab Sindhi restaurant aye aur papad nahi try kiya toh kya kiya?
Well this Modak shaped yummy papad made out of soaked rice is a must try. Highly recommended 👍
🔹Sindhi Pani Puri - So the puris are not crunchy but rather khasta and believe me they literally melt in your mouth and the beautiful flavour of masaledaar aloo stuffing along with sweet and spicy chutney is too good.
🔹Chole Pattice - I wonder why I never tried this dish from their menu. It was our absolute favourite and we ordered for 2 more plates. So basically it was crunchy aloo pattice which was stuffed with spicy Chana dal and served along with perfectly cooked mildly spiced chole which balanced the flavour beautifully, accompanied with pav and green chutney to adjust the spice level as per your liking. Highly recommended 👍
🔹Sindhi Thali - The complete package😜😜
Cos you get to taste so many varieties on a go.
I personally love the combination of bhuga chawal with Sindhi curry and sai bhaji with paratha.
🔹Sev Mithai - Do not leave this place without having their master piece.. Trust me it’s one of the best loaded with ghee and mawa. Highly recommended 👍
🔹Pan Milkshake - Nice and nutty paan flavour, served absolutely chilled.

Overall my girls were super happy as they all stay nearby and thanked me for introducing” Juss by sindhful “ to them 😍

featured_reviews.name: Mrugesh Samel
featured_reviews.review_text: This place is surely one of the best in Mumbai. Simple, authentic regional Indian food prepared using good quality ingredients seems to be their mantra and surely it's working well. Bheeyan ji tikki, Sai bhaji, Sindhi curry, singhar ji mithai are highly recommended here. Do not miss out on this place.

featured_reviews.name: Foodadda Mumbai
featured_reviews.review_text:
Here's an outlet for authentic sindhi food & pure vegans. Our attendant Kuldeep's service was very nice. The staff members were polite and welcoming. It's nearby by Khar station, it  hardly takes 5mins to reach. The ambience is attractive. They have two floors seating section. The wall is painted beautifully with large frame of women in beautiful Indian attire, one side of the wall is full of bronze plates hanging all over the wall and scripts in hindi language, as we go ahead the wall is fully painted it's so beautiful with floral paintings and they have wooden tables, chairs which are very comfortable to seat.

Coming to the food :

In Mocktails (PE-PE-PE) :

Paan Milkshake : This was served in a bottle. The flavour of paan was just heaven. The first sip i took made me feel so refreshed, that i completed this shake in no time.

Mango Lassi : This was also served in a bottle. A mandatory drink in summers. It was tempting and nice as always.

In Appetizers (NASTO) :

Chola Dabla : It was mixture of pav, chole and chat. It was topped with spicy chutneys and curd. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED.

In Main Course (KHADO) :

Peeli Dal, Bhindi Basar, Steamed Rice And Phulkas :

It was the best combo meal. The best peeli dal I have ever ate, really authentic and delicious in taste. Bhindi basar was the basic bhindi cooked with tomatoes, it also tasted delicious.

Veg Sindhi Thali :

Here before they use you provide unlimited Thali but now they have changed it & keep it as limited one. And if you want you can add Sai Bhaji or Bhuga Chawal but for this you have to pay extra. Also there is option in between 2 Phulkas or 3 Pooris. This thali is really huge. The thali contains about 12 items and each one of the dishes were incredibly delicious. It has.

Aloo Tuk (2pcs)
Sindhi Curry
Paneer Makhani
Bhee Aloo Sabzi
Sai Bhaji
Bhuga Chawal
Steam Rice
2 Phulkas and 2 Pooris
Masala Chass
Kheecha Papad
Boondi Raita
Meetha Lola

In Dessert (KUCH MEETHO) :

Singhar Ji Mithai : This one is our favourite of the lot. And we will go back here just to have this dessert. It was made of sev & milk. It had a little gulkand taste and topped with some almonds. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED.

Overall a good place, totally worth it. Must visit this place.

featured_reviews.name: Sonali Punjabi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’m a sindhi and I was looking for someplace very authentic in sindhi taste when I was recommended Juss by sindhful. Juss in sindhi translates to magic, so this was my most awaited!
The food was heavenly. It was typically like “ghar ka khaana”, served really hot and with just the right amount of spices. Oil was minimal and the food was just perfectly cooked. The staff was very helpful and courteous, the the ambiance was very very transitional. I loved every moment I spent there.

featured_reviews.name: Srishti Kadam
featured_reviews.review_text:
The outlet is located at a walking distance from Khar railway station and serves some authentic dishes from Sindhi cuisine. Restaurants serving Sindhi food are very few and this one truly shines as one of the brightest amongst them. They also have good options in North Indian and Chinese food. Ordered the following from here :

Chilli Basil Broccoli & Mushroom - Broccoli and Mushroom sauteed in flavourful gravy, it tasted amazing. Mushroom was soft and the broccoli was a bit hard, the texture contrast was pretty good. Dry gravy was spicy and brought the whole dish together..

Chilli Oyster Chicken - Chunks of tender chicken cooked in oyster sauce with lots of garlic pieces, rendering the dish spicy with just a hint of sweetness. Bell peppers added the crunch in this one and we absolutely loved the flavour of the whole thing..

Chicken Kheema Pav - Looked very mouth-watering and it did deliver in terms of flavour. The quantity was great, considering that we could have easily eaten 6 pavs with the Kheema, but our tummies gave up. It was the right amount of spicy for a Kheema and the chicken was perfectly minced. Pav was soft and the eggs added that little extra..

featured_reviews.name: Nitika Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
We started with the paani puri which was delicious to the core .Super crisp puris stuffed with aaloo & boondi served with 2 types of sweet & tangy water made of imli & mint which was simply heaven . Loved it .

Next we tried the pakwan churra chaat sev puri which had pakwan as base topped wit sev , aaloo & different chutney making it immensely tasty .
It was surprising to enjoy clean , hygenic street style food in a place like kamla mill with foot tapping music , drinks & posh crowd all at highly pocket friendly rates .

We also tried a platter of deep fried sindhi special delicacies including aaloo & arbi tuk , bheeyan ji tikki & sanna pakora . Each of them had a different texture & flavour which was one better than the other & difficult to choose the best . Sprinkled with a lot of spices the freshly ground spices added a strong punch to the starters which we all thoroughly enjoyed .

We simply couldnt resist the temptation to order the special unlimited Sindhi thaali which consisted of rose sherbat , sindhi papad , aaloo tuk , sindhi curry , sindhi mutter paneer , daran ji bhaji , steamed rice , puris & sevai kheer . Every item had an identity of its own & the use of authentic masalas added the homely feel not unlike the regular commercial food available at food courts .
We simply couldnt stop ordering the sevai kheer was it was divine & perfectly balanced in all respect .A complete meal which was simply satisfying in all respect .

Thoroughly enjoyed the entire Sindhi experience .
Daddo Suttho !!!
( means very nice in Sindhi language )

featured_reviews.name: Food Chain Mumbai
featured_reviews.review_text:
Juss by Sindhful is a restaurant which specialises in Sindhi Food as their Main Cuisine and they have got this wall:- wherein you could find most of the famous words, phrases used by Sindhis, like - Dadho Sutho (Very Good), Acho Acho (Come Come), Mathe je Sur (Headache), Charyo Safa (Mad Lad) and many other Sindhi words/phrases, +1 for the quirky ambience.

It's quiet a cozy place and it boasts to be the first restaurant in India to serve unlimited Sindhi thali.

Anyway, let's start about food:-

Recommendations-

• Chole Pattice
• From Thali - Puri with Bhindi Basar, Alu Tuk, Pakoras, Sindhi Kadi with Rice
• Gulab Jamun

• Chole Pattice - 4/5

Heart Shaped Fried Potatoes with Channa embedded in it is served alongside Chole, Onions soaked in Chatni and 2 Luke warm pavs.

The Pattice and Chole tasted good, Pattice was not spicy as you would find the channa embedded in Pattice to be overwhelming at many places, and the Chole, too were not spicy and were rich in flavours.

I liked how they avoided making this classic sindhi dish spicy as it ruins the experience for me.

• Sindhi Unlimited Thali - 4.5/5

This Thali has all the signature sindhi dishes like; bhindi basar, sindhi kadhi, bhugga chawal, sai bhaji, alu tuk, pakoras which is served with rice and puri &/or roti along with Rose sherbet and last but not the least Gulab Jamun.

My favourite among the thali were pakoras, sindhi curry and rice, bhindi basar with puri, pakoras and Alu tuk.

Gulab Jamun served hot and it was topped with almonds. I liked it how Gulab Jamun was not too sweet as many places make the Gulab Jamun too sweet.

• Paan Milkshake & Guava Cooler - 3.5/5

Beverages at Juss are served in a glass bottle with their Branding on it.

Paan Milkshake has the refreshing flavour of Paan but it was little too sweet.

Guava Cooler was fruity and a worthy alternative to your regular Mojito because it is refreshing flavour and since it was mildly sweet, it was a perfect beverage to sip on during the meal.

featured_reviews.name: Preeti S
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ordered food from Sindhful last night and was really very good.
.

.

.

.

.

featured_reviews.name: Rahil Kotadia
featured_reviews.review_text:
This place by the Bawa Hotels Group is a good option if you’re in the mood for Punjabi food, just don’t walk in expecting completely authentic flavours. The taste is slightly toned down, but if you set your expectations right, you’ll actually enjoy the food.

The menu is quite well done, and the meal box options are a big plus. Makes ordering super easy without having to overthink or pick too many individual items.

Their parathas are definitely worth trying—served nicely with curd. Do ask for white butter separately though, as it’s not given by default and really makes a difference. The lassi is a must-have here, easily one of the better things on the menu.

Also, a special mention for the Kalimiri chicken shorba. It’s not on the menu, but if they have it, don’t miss it—it’s genuinely very good.

Ambience is nice and comfortable, so no complaints there. Service, however, is quite slow and needs serious improvement, which can get a bit frustrating.

Parking is another issue—since it’s close to the railway station, the area is always crowded and finding a spot is tough. Better to plan that in advance.

Overall, a good place to chill and enjoy a meal, as long as you’re okay overlooking the service and parking hassles.

featured_reviews.name: Suhani Mendonsa
featured_reviews.review_text:
Khar just got a delicious new reason to celebrate with Bawa Kitchen opening its doors this Lohri! From the first bite, it felt like a true Punjabi feast — rich, soulful and full of festive warmth. My absolute favourites were their creamy butter chicken, soft and flavourful chhole kulcha, and the super refreshing lassi that perfectly balanced the spices. Every dish tasted like it was made with love and tradition. If you’re craving authentic Punjabi flavours with a celebratory twist, this is the place to be — go check it out and treat yourself to a hearty, happy meal!
And yes, my festive Lohri fit was specially curated — can’t wait to share it with you all soon!

featured_reviews.name: Susheel Dharmani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Bawa Kitchen and had a good dining experience overall. The place has a simple yet comfortable ambience, perfect for a relaxed meal.
The food quality was nice, especially the North Indian dishes which were flavorful and well-prepared. Portion sizes were decent and prices felt reasonable for the location.
Service was quick and the staff was polite and attentive. It’s a convenient option if you’re staying nearby or looking for a reliable place to eat in Dadar.
Overall, a good spot for a casual meal with consistent quality.

featured_reviews.name: Jawahar Hingorani
featured_reviews.review_text:
I only gave 4 for atmosphere because there was no 4.5 or 4.75…and I got bitten by mosquitoes! The food was on point - I ordered Ajwaini Rawas for my appetizer and it came with this spicy tandoori salad (think Thai Som Yum but not as sweet or wet) and Green chutney which was the perfect accompaniment. For my mains I got the Mutton Beliram (don’t why it’s called that) which was nice and spicy, along with a roomali roti. I’d recommend ordering a naan instead - lots of very moorish sauce to lap up! Got some Jal Jeera with soda to wash it down (not sure about the boondi). Finished off with some Gulabjamun - there is definitely a hint of “Gulab” there! And just look at those soft, pillowy, inviting mounds. 😆

Overall Bawa Kitchen echoes the punjabi ethos when it comes to food. It’s definitely a place I’d recommend and visit again!

featured_reviews.name: Vijita Sonawane
featured_reviews.review_text: The Bawa Kitchen delivered a great dining experience—pure Punjabi vibes, full balle-balle. The ambience is lively and authentic, with vibrant cut-outs and the iconic “Khatiya” as a standout photo spot. Veg and non-veg starters are well curated and set the right tone for the meal. Special mention to Rahul for being an excellent host—his food suggestions and positive approach added real value to the experience. Overall, a visit that is absolutely worth it for good food, warm hospitality, and Punjabi flair.

featured_reviews.name: Prathamesh Bandivadekar
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently visited this amazing restaurant in Bandra, and it’s an absolute gem for lovers of Asian cuisine. The sushi here is hands down the best I’ve had in the city – fresh, flavorful, and perfectly rolled. Their Thai and Chinese dishes are equally impressive, with authentic taste and balanced spices. Seafood lovers will be in heaven with their wide selection of fresh, well-cooked options. The food presentation is top-notch, making every dish a visual treat before you even take a bite. The ambience is super cute and cozy, perfect for a casual date or dinner with friends. Despite the high quality, the prices are surprisingly reasonable. The service was attentive and friendly, adding to the overall experience. It’s definitely a must-visit spot in Bandra for anyone craving great Asian flavors. I’ll surely be coming back soon!

featured_reviews.name: Shraddha Nandlaskar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ordered Dynamite Roll (Chef’s Recommendation) from this restaurant through Zomato.
The package was in good condition but the sushi was a disaster. It was the ugliest sushi I have ever seen, I couldn’t understand what exactly they have made, it had no shape, not firm enough to hold it with chopsticks, absolute tasteless made with regular rice. Nothing like it was mentioned in the menu.
Kuai Kitchen never again.

featured_reviews.name: amin shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
📍 Kuai Kitchen – Khar West, Mumbai
🍱 Location: Shop No. 3/4, Mangal Bhavna, Khar Pali Rd, Khar West, Mumbai 400052
If you're a fan of sushi, dim sum, and pan-Asian cuisine, Kuai Kitchen is the place to be! The ambience here is aesthetic and welcoming, with both indoor and outdoor dining options that make it a perfect spot for a cozy meal or a catch-up with friends.
We started off with some refreshing mocktails — I tried the Martini mocktail, which was super refreshing and full of flavor. My brother went for the Panda Passion, and not only did it taste amazing, but the presentation was on point too!
Here’s what we ordered and absolutely loved:
🍤 Dynamite Prawns – perfectly crispy and packed with flavor.
🥟 Spicy Chicken Dumplings – delicious, with a rich, flavorful filling and great presentation.
🍣 Volcano Prawn Tempura Roll Sushi – visually stunning and tasted just as good as it looked.
🍗 Chicken with Chilli Oil and Spring Onion – bold flavors with a nice kick.
🍚 Blue Butter Japanese Fried Rice (Chicken) – cooked to perfection, flavorful, and unique in taste.
And finally, to end on a sweet note:
🍫 Labubu Chocolate Bao – a warm, gooey dessert bao that was absolutely mouthwatering!
✨ The service was top-notch. The staff were attentive and helpful, and the manager personally guided us through the menu. Every dish was presented beautifully, and the quality was consistent throughout.
💯 Overall: 10/10 Experience
Highly recommended for all lovers of Thai, Asian, sushi, and dim sum. Add this place to your food bucket list — you won't regret it!

featured_reviews.name: aditya mathur
featured_reviews.review_text:
FAKE HYPE. AVOID visit. Very disappointed. Nothing special atall. Just a mediocre pan Asia joint . Lets get straight to it. Came here as i read good reviews online but sadly it was all wrong.
We were a party of 10 who went here on a Saturday night.
Cons :
1. No valet when we arrived. Had to look for parking for 15 mins.
2. Less than enthusiastic staff and thats putting lightly.
3. Small place so getting a seating inside might be difficult.
4. Lotus stem and teriyaki bao were soo sweet that it felt like eating desert. This was conveyed to the management for feedback.
5. Tatse and portion of the dishes do not justify the its cost. Too steep for the kind of mideocre food available.
6. Steamed rice was undercooked and left untouched. We had given up by this time and resorted to looking elsewhere for dinner party 2 .
7. No alcohol. Alcohol would have helped in stuffing down some of the itmes we ordered or atleast numb our taste buds enough to appreciate the food.
Pros :
1. Ambience is neat and cosy.
2. The sushi was very well made and we all enjoyed it.
3. The menu is well curated with good variety of both veg and non veg options.
I dont know if this was a one off case or our choice of items was poor or the staff was overwhelmed on a Saturday night or was it just the normal standard here but the fact remains that we were truly disappointed 😔 by the experience.

customer_updates.text:
If you’re a south indian food lover! Go! Explore! This place is for us fellow dosa babies! But if you eat dosa idli vada once in a while, maybe you can find other happening options!
But Their gelato ice creams are to die for! Indeed the best gelato i have ever had, specially the coffee flavour 🤤

featured_reviews.name: Vinay Pasi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Mutuswami Cafe in Khar and really enjoyed the overall experience. The place has a simple, casual vibe but serves a wide variety of dishes—from authentic South Indian options to Mumbai street-style favourites.

The benne dosa stood out with its crispy texture and buttery flavour, while the idli was soft and fresh. The cheese pav bhaji and mushroom sukha combo added a nice desi touch to the meal. The mango milkshake and mango sheera were rich, sweet, and perfect to end on a high note.

Service was quick, though it can get a bit crowded during peak hours. Overall, it’s a great place for breakfast or a casual meal with good food and decent pricing. Would definitely visit again.

featured_reviews.name: sourabh debnath
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely loved my experience at muttuswami Khar🌟
Started with the refreshing Kala Khatta and Aam Panna coolers — both were perfect for the Mumbai heat. The Ghee Podi Idli was super soft and flavourful, while the Masala Benne Dosa was buttery, crisp and delicious. For mains, the Ghee Roast Mushroom with Appam and Chettinad Biryani were packed with authentic flavours and tasted amazing. Ended the meal with Payasam and Vanilla Gelato which made for the perfect dessert combo. Great food, comforting flavours and an overall amazing dining experience. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Mahima Pal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited the Khar outlet recently and absolutely loved the whole experience 🫶🏻

The café has such a warm and cozy vibe with a perfect blend of authentic South Indian flavours and modern café aesthetics. Every dish felt comforting, flavourful, and beautifully prepared.

We started with the Cheese Onion Uttappa which was soft, perfectly cooked, and loaded with cheese without overpowering the authentic taste. The Mutuswami Special Benne Dosa with paneer was honestly one of the highlights 🤤 crispy on the outside, buttery, rich, and filled generously with flavourful paneer stuffing.

The Ghee Roast Mushroom with Appam was another standout dish. The appams were soft and fluffy while the mushroom preparation had a beautiful spicy South Indian flavour that paired so well together. We also tried the Paneer Cheese Grilled Sandwich which was super cheesy, crisp, and comforting.

For drinks, the Chikoo Milkshake was thick, creamy, and refreshing, while the Kala Khatta Cooler from their summer specials was tangy, nostalgic, and perfect for the Mumbai heat.
Ended the meal with Mango Sheera and it was the sweetest ending possible 🤌🏻 warm, rich, and full of mango flavour without being overly sweet.

Loved the quality, presentation, ambience, and overall experience. Definitely a place I’d love visiting again for comforting South Indian food with a modern twist.

featured_reviews.name: Komal Jaisingh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Mutuswami is one of those simple, comforting south indian food places which serve superb food. Calm and relaxed vibe - no rush, no noise just pure happiness. We absolutely loved the Paper masala Dosa, and podi idli.. two of my favs here. Apart from that they also serve Grilled Sandwiches, Pav Bhaji and an amazing line up of dosas and juices.
Had to end our meal with the super amazing Pineapple Sheera and filter coffee !! Manawwar served us really well !

featured_reviews.name: harshad lagade
featured_reviews.review_text: South Indian place in Khar west, this place is open for 24*7. Authentic south indian vibes with good food. Apart from South Indian food, they also have  other food items like Pav bhaji and Biryani. We tried their special dosa, Iced Filter Coffee, Paneer Biryani and coffee Gelato. Overall we had awesome time. Do visit soon.

featured_reviews.name: FJT
featured_reviews.review_text:
I went to Muttuswami Café with my skeptical, firang partner. He loved it, and so did I.

We had the Muttuswamy Special Benne Dosa, which is a mix of Benne Dosa, Masala Dosa and Ghee Podi Dosa. We also had Idli Vada Rasam, Plain and Hazelnut Filter Coffee, and a Pineapple Sheera to top it off. All of it was delicious, as well as pleasing to the eye!

The restaurant has been done up beautifully - it feels like you're walking into another world. It's super clean, and all the little touches - from the dabbara set for the filter coffee, to the paan box for the mukhwaas - serve to further elevate the experience.

Special thanks to Gaurav for being so patient and helpful.

I only dock one star because the AC wasn't working, and it's upwards of 35 degrees C right now. But honestly, the food was worth it.

10/10, would recommend!

featured_reviews.name: Angel Trata
featured_reviews.review_text:
Loved that someone is doing the culture right. Beautiful restaurant with great interiors, the traditional wooden entry door, green plants on exterior, lovely high ceilings, beautiful ceiling detail, lovely wall art in subtle color tones, not loud and disturbing but understated elegance, the lighting and design were all impeccable
I loved the uniforms for wait staff, they all wore pristine white lungi and half sleeve shirts with a cloth on the shoulder
Very refreshing to see the traditional attire
All the staff was pleasant, warm, welcoming with big smiles
Food was delicious too, the ambiance really did it for me.
The price was extremely reasonable
They even have fresh churned ice creams.
We had the rasam, rasam Vada, aviyal and hoppers X 2  and tomato onion uttapa and the total was under 900INR

featured_reviews.name: Firdous Diaries
featured_reviews.review_text:
Pure South Indian comfort food with a beautiful ambience .
Crispy Sada & Masala Dosa, soft Malabar Parotta with rich Veg Kurma, flavorful Pav Bhaji, refreshing Mosambi & Pomegranate juices and a sweet Fruit Salad with Ice Cream .
Everything tasted fresh, authentic and perfectly balanced.
Beautiful , clean ambience with calm vibes, quick service and warm hospitality.Cafe Muttuswami, Khar West - a hidden gem for South Indian food lovers. Highly recommended & will definitely revisit.

featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the most well-known cafés in Bandra, we visited during Christmas week and had to wait about 10–15 minutes for a table.
We started with sweet potato fries. For starters, we ordered the Chicken Sunset Club panini, which was average, and the protein-loaded avocado toast, which was very filling. We also tried the peri peri pizza with a gluten-free base—it was crunchy and tasty.
For mains, we went with the chicken teriyaki bowl. We finished with desserts: strawberry chocolate cake and skinny chocolate cake.
Overall, the food was good, and the café offers plenty of healthy options.

featured_reviews.name: Ankan Singhal
featured_reviews.review_text:
We went to this famous cafe in Bandra and it's definitely a must try place.

We ordered Sourdough Mushroom corn toastie, Falafel Hummus Panini, Ice Mocha coffee and Kunafa Cheesake Chocolate.

Well let me start with the best which ia their Kunafa Cheesecake. I mean this may take you to heaven. This is the best fusion dessert I have ever taken. I am a cheesecake lover and i dont like people messing up with my cheesecake but this is just 👍 👌
The sourdough toastie was good as well. It was creamy with mushrooms and corn in it.

The Falafel hummus Panini was just okay. It was on little dry side. I would have preferred a better salad or salad with a dressing to balance the dryness in this panini sandwich.

And it last the coffee. I don't think i am gonna try that again.  It was very okayish with no specific flavour. The chocolate was also liquid and was stuck on the sides.

Overall it was a good experience and definitely calls for a second visit for cheesecake

featured_reviews.name: rushda moulvi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve been coming to Farmers Café for years and after being away from India for a year, this was one place I couldn’t miss visiting. It’s genuinely one of my favourite spots in Mumbai.

The food, as always, was 10/10. I especially love their desserts and smoothies they’ve always been a highlight for me.

The only downsides this time were that the staff didn’t feel very friendly, and the tomato ketchup (which I usually love) smelled a bit off during this visit.

Still a place I really enjoy and hope these small things improve because the food quality has always been excellent.

Absolutely loved this place. The owner has created something truly special! not just a cafe, but a space built around compassion and conscious living. The quality of ingredients really shows, and it proves that plant-based food can be both nourishing and incredibly satisfying.

What makes it even more meaningful is the purpose behind the cafe, promoting kindness, non-violence, and respect for all species. Truly inspiring.

featured_reviews.name: Yash Rungta
featured_reviews.review_text:
A recent vegan lunch at Rare Earth Cafe turned out to be a genuinely delightful surprise.

Coming from a vegetarian family but someone who enjoys meat and seafood outside, I’ve always felt that the real advantage of being non-vegetarian is the freedom to eat anything—vegan, Jain, or otherwise. This place reinforces that idea beautifully.

Their cashew cheese is truly top-notch. It’s different from dairy cheese, but in a way that feels like an upgrade rather than a compromise. Everything tastes thoughtfully crafted. The flours they use—millets or emmer wheat—are light and easy to digest, which you can actually feel after the meal.

And the dessert? Easily a 7-star experience.

What stands out is their commitment to making everything in-house, using natural ingredients as much as possible. It shows in every bite.

You don’t need to be vegan to enjoy this place. Whether you’re vegetarian, non-vegetarian, eggetarian, Jain, or vegan—this café is absolutely worth a visit.

featured_reviews.name: V J
featured_reviews.review_text: A hidden culinary treasure tucked away in an unassuming building. Don’t be deceived by the exterior—the cuisine is exceptional, with every bite crafted with meticulous care and intention. This restaurant is essential for those with celiac disease or following a vegan diet. Begin your unforgettable gastronomic adventure with the sushi rolls, which serve as an excellent introduction to the menu. The proprietor is welcoming and has clearly procured premium ingredients. I’m confident this was my first experience tasting authentic wasabi.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

featured_reviews.name: Hania
featured_reviews.review_text:
Peach Ice Tea
Peach Iced Tea is a refreshing burst of flavor in every sip.

Kalimiri Cheddar Broccoli
From the moment the dish arrives, the vibrant green of the broccoli is contrasted beautifully by the creamy richness of the cheddar cheese, infused with the subtle yet captivating warmth of kalimiri (black pepper). The aroma is inviting—cheesy, slightly spicy, and earthy.The broccoli retains a nice crunch, providing a fresh, earthy base to the dish. The cheddar is indulgently smooth, delivering a familiar, comforting creaminess. But what sets this dish apart is the kalimiri. The black pepper’s spice gently lingers, balancing the richness of the cheese with a subtle heat. The tender yet slightly crisp broccoli pairs wonderfully with the velvety melted cheddar. Perfect for those looking for something familiar with a hint of spice. However, the spice of cardamom was overpowered and sat on tongue, so every bite was full of cardamom, which made the next dishes taste like it too.

Tiranga Kofte
Visually, the Tiranga Kofte presents itself well, with three distinct layers symbolizing the colours of the Indian flag. The presentation is appealing and sets high expectations for a flavourful experience. However, the dish's appearance slightly outweighs its taste. The kofte has a decent blend of spices, though the flavours don’t quite come together as cohesively as expected. Each layer brings something different—the green layer offers a mild herbiness, the white layer is a bit bland, and the orange section has a touch of heat. However, the balance between them feels uneven, with the spices not blending as harmoniously as they should.
Since the appetizer had cardamom hint which was overpowering, the outer layer green part of kofta also felt it had cardamom which wasn’t pleasant on tongue.

Amritsari Kulcha
The Amritsari-styled kulcha is a delightful treat. Each bite offers a perfect blend of crispy exterior and soft, flavorful interior. The traditional stuffing of spiced potatoes and herbs is well-seasoned, providing a hearty and satisfying taste

Lachha Paratha
The Lachha Paratha is a standout with its perfectly layered, crispy texture. Each bite reveals a delightful combination of flaky. Though they forgot to add butter because it was some miscommunication, It was perfect size not big not small.

Tadkewali Dal
Tadkewali Dal delivers a heartwarming, flavorful experience. The smoky aroma from the tadka (tempering) hits you immediately, preparing your senses for a rich and comforting dish. The lentils are cooked to perfection—and well-spiced. The tadka of ghee, cumin, garlic, and chilies adds depth, bringing a savory warmth to every bite. Each spoonful is a harmonious blend of velvety dal and robust, fragrant spices. It’s a perfect dish for anyone seeking bold yet balanced flavors in a simple, soul-satisfying homely meal.

Jeera rice
Jeera Rice is simplicity at its finest. The delicate aroma of cumin wafts through each grain, giving the rice a warm, earthy fragrance. The cumin seeds add a subtle crunch and a toasted, nutty flavor that complements the perfectly cooked, fluffy rice.

Halwa (Complementary)
Rich and buttery, each spoonful melts in your mouth, releasing a wave of sweetness that’s perfectly balanced with hints of cardamom. The texture is smooth yet slightly grainy, with bursts of flavor from the roasted nuts scattered throughout.

Hospitality
The hospitality at this restaurant is exceptional. From the moment we walked in, the staff was warm, attentive, and welcoming. They ensured every detail was taken care of, making us feel comfortable and valued throughout the meal. Service was prompt, yet never rushed, with the team showing genuine care in their recommendations and interactions. Their professionalism, combined with friendly smiles, truly elevated our experience. Ashish and Prasad served great hospitality to us.

Ambience
The ambience of Rasoi strikes the perfect balance between luxury and comfort. The decor is elegant yet welcoming, with soft lighting and tasteful accents that create a warm, inviting atmosphere

featured_reviews.name: Neelesh Sehgal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Since the first day I turned vegetarian, I’ve basically been on this endless treasure hunt for food that’s not just veg, but also actually healthy. And honestly? Options are tragically limited. Even when something claims to be “healthy,” the variety is usually so meh that you start questioning all your life choices.

Cut to almost 800 days later — I’m magically introduced to Ms. Purna, the soul behind this adorable little Bandra café called Purnah: And since that day? I’ve gone to Bandra twice… and both times I’ve marched straight into this café like it’s my second home.

If I had to sum up the place in one line: a spot where healthy is actually, genuinely delicious.
Freshly made Undhiyu; a super fun twist on Sev Puri and wraps that can make anyone abandon their diet trauma, and names of the dishes that make you smile before you even taste anything.

And the best part? They’ve got these super cool collabs with different organic brands (watch the video — you’ll see what I mean). All those products are available right there in the café. From organic snacks to clean-label goodies… AND achaar.
DESI and HEALTHY achaar.
OMG. Tasty tasty. Like the kind that reminds you of home but without the guilt.

And then there’s the owner — now officially a friend — who is honestly a vibe in herself. She will keep feeding you out of pure love until you decide to leave - which… good luck with that - the hardest part of the entire experience.

Oh, and it’s vegan. Which means the coffees come with cashew milk or hazelnut milk. I know, I know — “Who even does that?” was exactly my thought. But I tried the cashew milk coffee and it was actually prettyyy good. Strong. Different. But in a good way.

If you’re ever in Bandra, do NOT skip Purnah:. Your taste buds deserve good food, and your body deserves healthy food — and somehow, magically, this place gives you both.

featured_reviews.review_text:

Every dish is clearly created with immense care, intention, and depth of knowledge, beautifully embodying the idea that “food is medicine.”
The meals are not only delicious but deeply nourishing and healing—for both body and mind. On top of that, the staff are incredibly friendly and knowledgeable, which makes the whole experience even more special.
I genuinely can’t recommend this place highly enough!

And the Litti Pockets with all its sides and assortments was truly a winner! The Kimchi Rice blew our mind! We ordered one Cacao Elixir after another - a perfectly balanced beverage in flavour and texture! And this wasn't even the best part. Purna, the owner and a Culinary Medicine expert, not only provided us so many personalised insights to help us heal better - but also shared such an inspiring journey of her own that we really left the place with so much hope, love and happiness! She also made me a very delicious seasonal sweet treat - her own innovative take on it just like most of the food there - to make my birthday that much more special! I'm going back literally next week with my in-laws and then with my friends too - because I can't wait to try the rest of the menu! It's a beautiful cafe run by such an inspiring human ❤️ Highly recommend it to anyone and everyone - whether or not you're vegan - it will be as amazing for your tongue and your body! 😍

featured_reviews.name: Kuldip Deshmukh
featured_reviews.review_text:
All Saints in Khar West is one of those places that gets the vibe just right. The ambiance strikes a great balance between cozy and stylish, making it perfect for everything from casual dinners to weekend catch-ups. The lighting and decor create a relaxed yet slightly upscale feel without being intimidating.

The food is definitely a highlight. Their menu leans towards European and comfort-style dishes, and most items are well-executed with good portion sizes. The small plates are great for sharing, and the flavors are generally spot on. That said, a few dishes can feel a bit hit-or-miss depending on the day.

The drinks menu is equally impressive, with a good selection of cocktails and spirits. The cocktails are creative without being overcomplicated, and the bartenders seem to know their craft.

Service is friendly and attentive, though it can slow down during peak hours. It’s not a dealbreaker, but something to keep in mind if you’re visiting on a busy evening.

Overall, All Saints is a solid choice if you’re in Khar and looking for good food, great drinks, and a chill atmosphere. It’s not the cheapest option in the area, but the experience makes it worth a visit.

featured_reviews.name: Bhavin Parekh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Located in the lively neighborhood of Khar West, Mumbai, All Saints positions itself as a modern European-inspired bar & kitchen with strong continental influences. It blends the energy of a stylish cocktail bar with the comfort of an upscale casual dining space. The vibe feels contemporary, slightly edgy, and perfect for evenings out. The place leans heavily into a dark, moody aesthetic with Dim, warm lighting and plush seating with cozy corners ideal for Date nights, after-office drinks, small celebrations and weekend social gatherings.
The menu focuses on European, Italian, and global small plates, designed to pair well with drinks.
• Tapas & Small Plates: Well-portioned, good presentation. Loved its crystal dimsums, Asparagus tempura sushi, Kunafatart thecha paneer, Falafel pita pockets, Charred creamy brocolli.
• Mains: Creamy, indulgent, comfort-forward. Spinach Ricotta Ravioli, Asian Tofu bowl and Burmese Khaosuey.
• Dessert : Loved its Pistachio Rose Tres leches, Sin bowl of Joy. Both were yummy and scrumptious.
The bar is one of All Saints’ strongest elements. Signature cocktails like Gravity, Adam & Eve, Melon Gimlet, Zesty Momotaro and Rose Mallow Grita are creative and balanced and Mocktails like Makrut Pina, Shirley Temple and Kawachi are executed well. Bartenders are knowledgeable and happy to customize drinks.
All Saints, Khar is a solid experience if you're looking for a stylish bar-restaurant hybrid with good food and better cocktails. It’s more about the overall vibe and social experience than just the meal. If you're planning a visit, evenings post 8 PM are when the place truly comes alive.

The dark, moody interiors with warm lighting and cozy corners make it ideal for date nights, after-office gatherings, or relaxed evenings with friends.
The menu features global small plates and comfort-forward mains that pair well with the bar offerings.
Standout dishes include charred creamy broccoli, crystal dimsums, spinach ricotta ravioli, and the Asian tofu bowl — all well-presented and flavourful.
The bar truly shines with creative cocktails like Gravity and Rose Mallow Grita, along with refreshing mocktails.
Desserts such as pistachio rose tres leches and the Sin Bowl of Joy are indulgent and worth saving room for. Overall, All Saints delivers a complete, vibe-driven dining experience.

featured_reviews.name: Harshad Dhamankar
featured_reviews.review_text:
All Saints – Khar West
Tucked away in the lively lanes of Khar West, All Saints is one of those places that instantly impresses you with its calm yet classy vibe. The moment you step inside, you’re welcomed by a beautifully designed space featuring warm ambient lighting, soft earthy tones, elegant wall textures and a stunning glass ceiling that adds an open and airy feel to the entire restaurant. The aesthetic pendant lights and minimal décor create the perfect balance between sophistication and comfort — making it an ideal spot for both casual dinners and special evenings.
Mocktails
Their mocktail menu is refreshing and thoughtfully curated. Each drink is well-balanced — not overly sweet, yet packed with flavour. Perfectly chilled and beautifully presented, these beverages complement the overall dining experience and set the tone for what’s to come.
🍽️ Starters
The starters here are full of flavour and presented with great attention to detail. From cheesy, crispy bites to perfectly spiced appetisers, every dish carries a unique taste profile that blends global flavours with a subtle desi twist. The portion size is satisfying and ideal for sharing.
Mains
Moving on to the mains, the pizzas are definitely a highlight! Loaded with toppings, a generous layer of cheese and a perfectly baked crust — every bite feels indulgent yet balanced. The quality of ingredients really stands out, especially in dishes that feature fresh vegetables and paneer toppings. Comfort food lovers will truly enjoy the hearty and flavourful options available here.
Desserts
No meal is complete without dessert, and All Saints does not disappoint! The desserts are rich, decadent and beautifully plated. From smooth chocolate-based treats to light and creamy delights, the sweetness is just right — making it the perfect ending to a memorable meal.

featured_reviews.name: Rahul Sonkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
The ambiance is honestly one of the best parts of this place. It has a classy yet cozy vibe with dim lighting, elegant interiors, and a perfect mix of modern and vintage aesthetics. Whether you’re going for a chill dinner or a special evening, the vibe just sets the mood right.

Coming to the food – absolutely delicious. Every dish was well-presented and full of flavor. You can tell they focus on quality ingredients and balanced taste. The portions were satisfying, and everything we ordered was on point. Definitely a place where you’ll want to try multiple dishes.

Service was equally impressive. The staff was polite, attentive, and quick without being intrusive. They guided us well with recommendations and made sure we were comfortable throughout.

Overall, All Saints is a perfect combination of great ambiance, quality food, and warm service. Would definitely visit again! ⭐⭐⭐⭐✨

featured_reviews.review_text:
I ordered an Arrabbiata pasta and asked them to replace mushroom with another vegetable. That’s it. Not extra toppings, not some complicated off-menu request — just replacing one vegetable.

And honestly, calling that a “special customization” is ridiculous. It’s pasta, not a five-course tasting menu. Also, I have genuinely never seen mushroom in an Arrabbiata pasta on any normal menu, so acting like removing it was some massive inconvenience was bizarre from the start.

The pasta arrived completely dry, non-palatable, and barely edible, so I gave it 2 stars on the app. I didn’t even write a review initially. But apparently that was enough to trigger the owner into calling me at 11 PM to argue about why I gave a low rating.

The entire call was just constant interruption, defensiveness, and repeated lectures about how they had gone “out of their way” for me by replacing one vegetable with another. If that is considered some massive favour, then maybe don’t offer it at all.

What’s worse is the complete inability to take feedback. If you ask a customer what went wrong, at least let them speak instead of interrupting them every few seconds.

In the restaurant business, bad food is still fixable. This kind of behaviour is what actually ruins the experience. Calling customers late at night to fight over a rating is genuinely bizarre and unbelievably unprofessional.

Definitely not ordering again.

featured_reviews.name: Vinit Vinayak
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Muthuswamy Cafe, and it was an amazing experience for anyone who loves authentic South Indian food.

The place has a simple yet comforting vibe, and the aroma itself sets the mood as soon as you walk in. The food is absolutely top-notch—fresh, flavorful, and perfectly balanced. From crispy dosas to soft idlis and rich sambhar, everything tasted authentic and satisfying.

The service was quick and efficient, and the staff was polite and attentive throughout. It’s one of those places where you go for the food and end up loving the whole experience.

If you’re in Dadar and craving real South Indian flavors, this spot is definitely worth visiting!

featured_reviews.name: Himanshi Patel
featured_reviews.review_text: Café Muthuswami in Dadar is a cozy spot that brings authentic South Indian flavors to life. Known for its crispy dosas, soft idlis, and rich, aromatic filter coffee, every bite feels comforting and nostalgic. The ambiance is simple yet inviting, perfect for casual catch-ups or a relaxed solo meal. Service is quick, and the food quality is consistently impressive. Whether you’re craving a hearty breakfast or a light evening snack, this café delivers on both taste and experience. A must-visit for anyone who loves traditional South Indian food in Mumbai with a homely touch and great value.

featured_reviews.name: Pooja Fulsundar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Mutuswami Cafe is located just outside Dadar East railway station, so it’s very easy to find and perfect for a quick stop after travel. They have both indoor and outdoor seating, which is nice if you want to sit comfortably or just grab something quickly.
We tried the strawberry milkshake & mango milkshake both were thick, chilled, and refreshing. The paper masala dosa was big, crispy, and came with good chutney and sambar. Kanchipuram idli was soft and flavourful, a little different from regular idli and worth trying.
Cheese tava rice was spicy, cheesy, and filling good if you’re very hungry. We ended with pineapple sheera, which was warm, slightly sweet, and had a nice fruity taste.
Overall, it’s a good place for South Indian food and quick snacks near the station.

featured_reviews.name: VISHAL UPADHYAY
featured_reviews.review_text: We ordered cheese pav bhaji, and masala dosa and both were extremely delicious. We loved both the items. Cost wise it appeared a little costly given the ambience, and quality of service. It was situated near Dadar railway station and is fine for some snacking.

featured_reviews.name: Gayatri
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you’re in Dadar and craving authentic South Indian flavors any time of the day, Muttuswami Cafe is the place to be!
This is the only café in the area open 24/7, making it a perfect spot for early breakfasts, late-night cravings, or casual meetups at any hour.
The food quality is outstanding, with every dish served fresh, flavorful, and satisfying:
Cheese Pav Bhaji – perfectly buttery with a generous layer of melted cheese that elevates the classic taste.
Podi Idli – soft, bite-sized idlis coated beautifully in spicy podi masala and ghee.
Muttuswami Special Benne Dosa – rich, crispy, and soaked in butter with a delicious traditional touch.
Spring Dosa – a unique fusion twist, crispy outside with a flavorful stuffed filling inside.
Fruit Custard Dessert – creamy, refreshing, and loaded with fresh fruits for the perfect sweet ending.
Their fresh juices are equally impressive — especially the pomegranate juice and the orange-mosambi mix, both refreshing and naturally sweet.
What truly makes the experience special is the warm and polite staff. The service is quick, attentive, and always delivered with a smile. The beautiful interiors create a clean, cozy, and welcoming atmosphere, making you want to sit back and enjoy your meal.

featured_reviews.name: imran khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
This place is located very near to Dadar East railway station... AC dining room. But the space is very small. Outdoor sitting area is spacious but one cannot sit there during daytime.
Food was amazing tasty. A little higher price.. people may feel for this .. however if you compare to food outlets in the mall .. it's the same. Combos one can have .. quantity fulfills  the hunger for one person. Overall nice experience. Recommended if around Dadar railway station.

featured_reviews.name: Taran Arora
featured_reviews.review_text: If you enjoy South Indian food and want a cleaner, more café-style experience in Dadar, Mutuswami is worth trying. Best dishes to order are Benne dosa, thatte idli, rasam rice , filter coffee and pineapple sheera.  Staff is very courteous and welcoming.

featured_reviews.name: Mithil Thakker
featured_reviews.review_text:
This one has become our most favourite go to place whenever close to Dadar East Station.

They have indoor and outdoor seating. Post 8 pm it's a busy schedule for the restaurant so go a bit early to get the best available table of the house.

Our food recommendations.

Podi Idli:
You have to visit this place to experience this extraordinary delicacy of the house .

Benne Masala Dosa:
This one won't disappoint you if you are fond of benne then definitely give this a try.

Pav Bhaji:
Again a house supremacy. Spicy and Tangy burst of flavours with every bite .

The Mango Milkshake was rich and thick  . Even their cold coffee has a supreme vibe.

Pineapple Sheera .
When at a South Indian cuisine specialist restaurant then you can't miss this legendary dish . Indeed a heavenly experience.

Overall a delightful experience as always.

Happy and Safe Fooding Until Next Time.

featured_reviews.name: Gayatri
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a wonderful lunch at Rasoi and everything was simply delightful!
• Firdausi Aloo – Perfectly spiced, rich and flavourful with a royal touch.
• Karari Rumali Roti – Crisp, light and beautifully done with the right crunch.
• Corn & Water Chestnut Starters – Fresh, crunchy and a great balance of sweetness and spice.
• Aromatic Green Thai Curry – Fragrant, creamy and packed with authentic flavours.
• Zafrani Rasmalai – Soft, melt-in-the-mouth and infused with delicate saffron notes.
• Anar Ka Pyaar (Mocktail) – Refreshing, fruity and perfectly balanced.
• Thanda Teekha (Mocktail) – A fun blend of sweet and spicy that really stood out.
The service was quick and seamless, and the staff was extremely knowledgeable about the menu, offering great recommendations. Since we visited on Holi, they surprised us with complimentary Jalebi Rabdi and Thandai, which made the celebration even more special.
A truly memorable dining experience — highly recommended! 🌸✨

featured_reviews.name: Akshaya Vishwakarma
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited this place, and the experience was absolutely wonderful. The ambience is cozy, aesthetically pleasing, and perfect for a relaxed meal.

For drinks, I tried the Virgin Mojito and Oreo Milkshake, and both were refreshing and delicious. As starters, we ordered the Rasoi Paneer Tikka and Bhatti Da Murg, which were flavorful, perfectly cooked, and truly satisfying.

For the main course, we had Paneer Nimbu Da Pyaaza with Rumali Roti and Schezwan Fried Rice. Both dishes were excellent, packed with flavor, and complemented each other really well.

To finish the meal, we indulged in their Rasmalai, which was the perfect ending—soft, rich, and absolutely delightful.

Overall, everything from the food to the ambience exceeded expectations. A highly recommended place for anyone looking to enjoy great food and a pleasant dining experience!

featured_reviews.name: Foodie Crown
featured_reviews.review_text:
Recently visited Rasoi near Dadar Station and had a wonderful dining experience. The restaurant offers a great mix of North Indian, Malwani, and Chinese cuisine, making it a good option for groups with different food preferences.

We started with the Chicken Sheekh Kebab and Chicken Tikka, both of which were flavorful, juicy, and perfectly cooked. For the main course, we tried the Thai Curry, which was rich, creamy, and packed with authentic flavors.

To accompany our meal, we ordered a Fruit Punch mocktail that was refreshing and well-balanced. We ended the meal with their Sizzling Brownie, which was served hot and was the perfect sweet treat to finish on.

The food quality, taste, and portion sizes were impressive. The service was prompt, and the location near Dadar Station makes it a convenient spot for a satisfying meal. Definitely worth a visit if you're in the area and looking for delicious food across multiple cuisines.

featured_reviews.name: Shraddha Viswakarma
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Rasoi recently and honestly, it’s one of those places that just gets everything right. The ambience and decor are super aesthetic yet warm, making it perfect for literally anyone—families, couples or even chill friend scenes.

The place was quite packed when we went, but the crowd added to the vibe instead of feeling chaotic. Service was genuinely top-notch—staff was quick, polite and very attentive.

We tried the Watermelon & Basil Martini and Anar Ka Pyaar—both refreshing and beautifully presented. Starters like Balinese BBQ Chicken and Sigri Murgh were full of flavour and perfectly cooked. For mains, the Nawabi Murgh with Butter Garlic Naan was rich and comforting, and the Chicken Dum Biryani was aromatic and satisfying.

They also had a live singer which elevated the whole experience. Ending it with Mango Kulfi Falooda (seasonal aamras specials!) was just perfect. Great food, great vibe, and totally worth it.

featured_reviews.name: Aafreen Mulla
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a wonderful experience at Dadar Rasoi! It’s a perfect place to visit with family and loved ones. The ambience is warm and welcoming, making it a great spot to celebrate birthdays, anniversaries, and special occasions.
The live music adds a lovely vibe to the dining experience, and the service was excellent throughout our visit. The staff was polite, attentive, and made us feel comfortable.
The food was absolutely delicious — everything was well-cooked, flavorful, and served fresh. Every dish tasted amazing and was prepared with great quality.
Highly recommended for anyone looking for good food, good music, and a memorable time with family or friends. Must visit this place!

featured_reviews.name: Pranali Kadam
featured_reviews.review_text:
Rasoi is an amazing place for authentic North Indian comfort food. The food tastes just like simple, fresh, and full of flavour.

We tried their North Indian dishes and everything was perfectly cooked. and the food was not oily or heavy.

Great hygiene, good portions, quick service, and affordable prices.
Perfect spot 😍😍
Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: tanishka_on_the_go
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently visited Rasoi in Dadar East and had a wonderful experience. The ambience is very pleasant and comfortable, perfect for a relaxed meal. The staff is extremely polite, attentive, and makes you feel welcome. We tried the Tamarind Ginger Sour and Fruit Sangria, both were refreshing and well balanced. The Sigri Murgh was smoky and full of flavour, cooked perfectly. Chicken Patiala Seekhan and Nukkad Wali Biryani were absolutely delicious and rich in taste. Kombdi Wade was authentic and comforting. We ended the meal with in-house Kulfi Falooda which was amazing. Overall, Rasoi has great food, great service, and a lovely vibe. Highly recommended 👍
